units.source_text: 阿雪的父亲是临时搬运工，到这里来干活，住在邻村老乡家铺着旧榻榻米的库房里。

en.t: Ayuki's father was a temporary porter who had come here for work and was living in a storehouse laid with old tatami mats at the home of someone from his village in the neighboring village.

units.source_text: 在故乡港町，从海边温泉街到另一条温泉街的半道上，有一个渔港，她爷爷就住在那里，等着孙女送来烟草和腌山嵛菜。

en.t: In her hometown port town, halfway from the seaside hot-spring district to another hot-spring district, there was a fishing harbor; her grandfather lived there, waiting for his granddaughter to bring tobacco and pickled wasabi greens.
